_doc: Contract for a person the owner marked deceased (CM041 SuggestionSuppression, suppressReason "deceased", case-insensitive). Emitted on /people, /people/search, /people/context, /api/v1/people/{slug}/enrichment and /api/v1/person/{slug}/timeline (person). Consumers: CM031 iOS People views, ostler-assistant chat context. A do-not-suggest person (any other reason) carries suggestions_suppressed only and keeps every field. When the record cannot be read, every person on that response carries suppression_check "unavailable" and none of must_not_have. Synthetic cast only.
